errors.chooseImage: Choose an image (PNG, JPG, SVG, WEBP)

language.title: Language
language.hint: Choose the interface language for your account.

currency.title: Display Currency
currency.hint: Choose the currency amounts are shown in across the dashboard. Data is always stored in LEK — this only changes how it's displayed, not invoices or payments.

colors.title: Dashboard Colors
colors.hint: Choose the color palette for every account at the clinic. Dark mode always stays white/gray/black, regardless of the palette.

custom.title: Custom Color
custom.hint: Pick any color — the rest of the palette (dark shades, backgrounds, charts) is generated from it automatically.
custom.errorFormat: Color must be in hex format (e.g. #3B82F6)

surface.title: Interface Style
surface.hint: Choose how cards, the sidebar, and menus look for every account at the clinic. Works with any color palette above.

font.title: Dashboard Font
font.hint: Choose the typeface used across the dashboard for every account at the clinic. All options are free, open-license Google Fonts.

custom.title: Custom Font
custom.hint: Upload your own font (WOFF2, WOFF, TTF, or OTF) to use instead of the presets above.
custom.dropzone: Click or drag a font file here (.woff2, .woff, .ttf, .otf)
custom.errorType: Only WOFF2, WOFF, TTF, or OTF files are allowed

hours.title: Clinic Hours
hours.hint: Controls when the "How are you working today?" prompt appears for staff — it only shows up once the clinic has opened.

logo.title: Sidebar Logo
logo.hint: Shown at the top of the side menu. Horizontal PNG/SVG recommended, minimum 320×96 px.
logo.dropzone: Click or drag a PNG / SVG / WEBP image

favicon.title: Browser Icon (Favicon)
favicon.hint: Shown as a small icon in the browser tab. Square PNG/ICO recommended, 32×32 or 64×64 px.
favicon.dropzone: Click or drag PNG / ICO / SVG (square)

sidebarIcon.title: Collapsed Menu Icon
sidebarIcon.hint: Shown in place of the logo when the side menu is collapsed. Square PNG/SVG recommended, minimum 64×64 px.
sidebarIcon.dropzone: Click or drag a PNG / SVG / WEBP image (square)

chatbotIcon.title: AI Assistant Icon
chatbotIcon.hint: Shown on the floating chatbot button (bottom right). Square PNG/SVG recommended, minimum 64×64 px.
chatbotIcon.previewCaption: Shown instead of the default icon
chatbotIcon.dropzone: Click or drag a PNG / SVG / WEBP image (square)
